title: Starbucks K-Cup Coffee Pods, Dark Roast Coffee, Espresso Roast for Keurig Coffee Makers, 100% Arabica, 1 Box (75 Pods)
reviews: I was alerted to this portion of Amazon because I was expecting an order for coffee. However, it showed me when it would be arriving! Today! I am a coffee aficionado and this is the best I've ever had in all of my 63 years. I will continue to purchase it from Amazon from now on. Every time I get low on it, I'll order it again. I actually shopped for the best price after I finished my first box and without a doubt, Amazon offers the best price. No more Folgers Classic Roast pods EVER again. I've considered taking the unopened 2 boxes of 48 pods to the local veteran's home which is a few miles from me. This is the only coffee I'll drink for years to come! Please give it a try. Best coffee, best price for the least money in as much as I could find. The quality is outstanding!
That’s the one I buy, I have it with hazelnut creamer. To me it’s delicious

This Starbucks espresso roast is a taste that is unmatched amongst pods. To truly get that espresso taste it must be made in 2 ounce shots. The espresso comes out strong with very light hints of caramel. The bigger the brew, the less it will taste like espresso. Having a machine which does 2 ounce shots is best for these pods. It's a great value and saves you trips to get that exquisite flavor. Made in just 10 seconds, these pods will make you want more and more. Great for lattes, cappuccino, and espresso shots. I love the taste, 5 stars!
very good brew, I use the middle water level to keep it like expresso
Great bold flavor with little bitterness!!😎
Great price, it’s exactly what it says it is and so yummy
This isn't my favorite coffee but it's good. I have it on subscription so I am a return customer.
I love all Starbucks coffee. Espresso Roast is bold, full bodied and delicious. Can’t wait to have every morning!
